a: Break-even quantity = fixed costs / (price - variable cost per unit)
NPV sums discounted cash flows minus initial investment.
IRR is the discount rate that makes NPV zero.
Payback period is time to recover the initial investment from cash inflows.
Years to double ≈ 72 / interest rate percent.
Price elasticity ≈ % change quantity / % change price
Contribution margin = price - variable cost per unit
Burn rate is how fast a startup spends cash; runway = cash / burn.
